name: Vault Bases
description: Evaluated Base result sets for agents: enumerate the vault's `.base` files with their declared views, and evaluate a view through Obsidian's own Bases engine in a hidden background leaf — full filter/formula/sort fidelity, nothing re-implemented, nothing written. Published as MCP tools through the Governor host; the tools are absent unless the running Obsidian exposes the public Bases API (1.10+).
author: Nelson Love
